scenario:
A global tech company specializing in information retrieval solutions is developing an advanced analytics platform to evaluate the performance of its search engine algorithms. The platform will be used to collect, process, and analyze various retrieval effectiveness metrics such as NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain), AP (Average Precision), RR (Reciprocal Rank), and RBP (Rank-Biased Precision) across different configurations and datasets.

The analytics platform is designed to handle multiple datasets and search configurations. It will allow researchers and engineers to upload result sets, compute evaluation metrics, and track the performance over time. The platform should support the generation of detailed reports and visualizations to identify trends, strengths, and weaknesses in search engine performance.

Additionally, the system should facilitate collaboration among R&D teams by allowing them to share insights, discuss results, and propose improvements. User roles and permissions will be implemented to control access to data and analysis tools. The platform should also support the versioning of search algorithms and datasets to ensure the reproducibility of results and to track improvements over time.
